hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[10vw] uppercase font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-4xl md:text-6xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight text-white
hierarchy.h3: text-2xl md:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight text-white
hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.3em] font-bold text-[#00F0FF]

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for nav (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/5). Solid ultra-dark backgrounds elsewhere to let the product shine.
visual_enhancers.effects: Heavy use of negative space. Lusion-style pitch-black backgrounds where the product is the only source of color/light. Use a subtle noise/grain overlay (pointer-events-none, fixed, 3% opacity) to give a cinematic film feel.

motion_and_interactions.hero_scroll: CRITICAL: Implement a scroll-controlled hero sequence using framer-motion (useScroll, useTransform). Wrap the hero in a h-[300vh] or h-[400vh] container. Inside, use a sticky top-0 h-screen block. Map scrollYProgress to the wheel image: scale (e.g. 1 to 3), rotate (0deg to 180deg), and translate (center to offset). Synchronize text layer opacities to crossfade at scroll thresholds.
motion_and_interactions.text_reveal: Large typography sections (Lando Norris style) must use staggered line/word reveals using Framer Motion (initial: y: 100%, clip-path mask).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons should have magnetic feel or fill-slide effects. Text color must invert to black on hover against solid cyan background.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle y-axis parallax on background textures (like the carbon fiber) in sections below the hero.

layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous spacing: p-8, py-32, md:py-48. Use negative space aggressively.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Mix of dead-center alignment for massive impact headers and aggressive asymmetry (left-aligned giant text, right-aligned product stats).
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Sticky, minimal top nav (z-[100]). Logo on left, links center, Cyan CTA on right.

image_urls.description: Premium alloy wheel. MUST BE USED in the scroll-scrub section.
Cyan light bleed for dark sections. Use with mix-blend-screen or opacity-30.
Carbon fiber texture for engineering/specs section background. Overlay with gradient to black so it fades seamlessly.

components.nav: Custom HTML/Tailwind sticky nav with blur. data-testid='main-nav'
components.hero_scroll_section: Custom framer-motion wrapper (h-[400vh]) for scroll-timeline effects. data-testid='hero-scroll-container'
components.typography_mask: Custom framer-motion text block for staggered reveals. data-testid='staggered-text'
components.stats_counter: Framer motion useSpring/useMotionValue for animating numbers. data-testid='stat-counter'
components.marquee: react-fast-marquee for brand words strip. data-testid='brand-marquee'

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Add Fontshare links for 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Satoshi' to the main HTML or import via CSS.
ALL CONTENT MUST BE IN GERMAN.
Do NOT use generic Shadcn Card/Section components. Build completely custom, semantic HTML sections with pure Tailwind/Framer Motion to match the Lusion/LandoNorris high-end creative style.

HERO IMPLEMENTATION (CRITICAL): Create a <div className='h-[400vh] relative' data-testid='hero-scroll-container'>. Inside, use a <div className='sticky top-0 h-screen overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center'>. Inside that, place the wheel image. Use Framer Motion's useScroll to get the scrollYProgress of the wrapper. Map that progress to the image's scale (e.g., [0, 0.5, 1] -> [1, 2, 4]) and rotation (e.g., [0, 1] -> [0, 360deg]).

Overlay multiple text blocks (absolute positioned) inside the sticky hero that fade in and out based on the same scrollYProgress (e.g. Text 1 'DIE ZUKUNFT DER PERFORMANCE' visible at 0-0.3, Text 2 'AERODYNAMIK NEU GEDACHT' visible at 0.4-0.6).
Add a 'Spezifikationen' (Specifications) section with animated counting numbers using Framer Motion (e.g., 'Gewicht: 8.4 kg', 'Zoll: 21"'). Use the carbon fiber texture as a subtle background here.
Add a scrolling text marquee section featuring words like 'PERFEKTION', 'AERODYNAMIK', 'PRÄZISION' in outline text style.
Buttons should be striking: solid #00F0FF background with black text, zero border radius (rounded-none) for a brutalist, highly engineered feel.
Enforce APCA contrast ratios. Ensure all interactive and key elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='buy-button').
